payload.title: Membership index backfill for Prospectus accounts, then switch membershipLookup to indexed
payload.description:
State as of 2026-10-19 16:40Z. Prospectus PR 1 closed; PRs 18 and 20 merged (membership index, listings stay in scan mode). PRs 21, 23, 24, 25 and 26 were being landed: 23 and 25 merged, 24 (docs) in CI, 21 and 26 had fixes pushed and were waiting on CI.

Next step, Mac, read-only first: (1) aws amplify list-jobs --app-id d15sc1sptohtqb --branch-name main --max-items 3 to confirm the PR 18 build succeeded; (2) PROSPECTUS_BUILD_IDENTITY_S3=true npm run build:identity-files, then PROSPECTUS_ACCOUNTS_BUCKET=prospectus-records-712236451410 PROSPECTUS_ACCOUNTS_OWNER=712236451410 node --import tsx scripts/rebuild-membership-index.ts and send back the printed JSON. Then the write step (--write with PROSPECTUS_MEMBERSHIP_INDEX_APPROVAL=712236451410/prospectus-records-712236451410), which writes create-only markers to production S3.
Blocker: the write step needs Ryan's own typed approval on the Mac. After it runs, open the PR switching membershipLookup to indexed.
Owner thread: Prospectus accounts integration.
